<MethodEndpoint

  path={"/users/link-external-to-password"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>

Moves an external-only account's sign-in identities onto a password account and deletes the external-only account (admin only). A 2.8 SSO account whose only sign-in is the matching legacy OIDC link is accepted as the target too, to merge a duplicate made by 2.9.0.
